benchmarks.note: single-edge pattern into ring(n); get_subisomorphisms_lad enumerates 2n embeddings, exercising the full AllDifferent (Hopcroft-Karp matching + GAC) propagation and forward-checking. ~13-22x slower than the VF2 enumeration baseline (ALGO-ISO-002 subiso/count_edge_into_ring) — LAD's per-node CSP filtering buys stronger pruning on hard pattern instances but costs more on these trivially-satisfiable ones

P3 pattern into ring(n); first-match (subisomorphic_lad) decision. Super-linear: each filter() pass rebuilds per-vertex domains over the whole target (O(V) domain init + matching) before the first complete assignment is found, so cost grows faster than VF2's incremental backtracking on these sparse rings
